entries.developer_comments: ~ Description of compact bionic module 'Hub 01 XM-BACK Interface'
identity: Body area sensor networks were developed as unobtrusive, chip-free personalized medical devices, typically in the form of thin adhesive pads.  Hub 01 has adapted this technology into cybernetic implants that allow a neurobionic interface to communicate with external devices.  These implants will allow your neurobionic interface to communicate with Hub 01 Biomechanical Assisted Carrying Kinetoframes.
